budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver at least two milk portions from each of three herd owners to the shared barn before a herd loses all health; maintain grazing access, water and repairable gates.
task.natural_termination: Failure when any herd health reaches zero. Otherwise success when every owner's delivered count is at least two. Failure excludes simultaneous success; either natural cause takes priority over the cap.
task.interaction: Opening or repairing a gate changes another owner's herd route, grazing pressure and future milk. Shared trough water, regrowth neighborhoods, one bucket, one hammer and single-slot carrying make irrigation, repair, collection and delivery compete for the same workers.
task.observation_access: Fully observable. Every role receives its one-hot and all public obs_keys leaves: actual map, shepherds and their cargo, herd coordinates/owners/needs/health/milk, gate condition/open state, grass and rest, trough water, tool locations/holders/charges, facilities, boards and delivery/production events. Herd, tool and scene information is the same for humans and policies. No hidden animal target or private planner is exposed through rendering; target selection is recomputed directly from visible native state.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Gate toggle during this step; not a persistent open-state event.
Per-herd consumption of a grass portion this step.
Per-herd consumption of one trough serving this step.
Per-herd new milk portion this step.
Produce delivered this step by original herd owner.
A trough received bucket water this step.
A gate received hammer repairs this step.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
